captureLimitations: Element product/FAQ screenshots include sticky header/fixed action strip at the capture scroll position. Mobile full screenshots also capture the action strip around y842, obscuring a narrow strip of underlying content. Product/FAQ content is fully inspectable in corresponding full-page tiles, and home/first-banner strip areas are inspectable across desktop/other-width originals and exact DOM. These captures alone do not prove unobscured touch/focus targets at every scroll offset; no permanent content omission found in combined evidence.

Keyboard execution is runner-reported: skip link focused main and mobile menu click/Space/Enter toggled correctly. Source CSS defines focus-visible outlines, mobile scroll padding and footer bottom clearance, but no dedicated focused-state screenshot or full CTA/footer Tab traversal is present. A screenshot does not prove phone/external checkout success.
directObservations: Korean headings and prose wrap without offscreen clipping; one coherent title and visually distinct sections.

Home shows three approved banners and one article card, with no product grid. Detail shows four actual product photos and basic prices of 59,000, 79,000, 109,000 and 149,000 KRW, with exact SKU links. Shipping-inclusive final amounts require consultation. Namgu shipping cost remains unknown; no fixed fee, free delivery or fabricated final total is stated.
All three FAQ question/answer pairs are visibly expanded in full-page coverage; sources and final consultation CTA remain present.
Support contains one child and no marketing banners. The technical 404 page and unknown-path response provide a clear home recovery action.
Mobile fixed bottom home/phone strip is visible; desktop omits mobile strip. Product photos retain full square image area, with no stretched or broken placeholders.
method: Every unique screenshot was directly viewed across full-page, viewport and product/FAQ crops. Long full-page screenshots were inspected through exhaustive, non-resized vertical tiles. Byte-identical 404 variants share inspected pixels; support viewport pixels were compared against their full-page originals. All 36 original files retain their hashes. No screenshot was regenerated or replaced.
reviewer: Independent Namgu artifact and pixel reviewer

sourceAccessibilityBaseline.scope: Direct source inspection only; this does not replace full keyboard and every-scroll interaction tests.
